objective: Speed up score_matrix without changing its values. Entry [i][j] is the dot product of rows[i] and cols[j]. The passes argument repeats that identical calculation and averages it, so the mathematical result does not depend on passes when passes is a positive integer. A correct speedup must keep the values and beat the untouched baseline by at least 2x under paired timing whose A/A noise stays inside the grader band.
does_not_establish: A passing timing gate is a CPU microbenchmark of this function. It is not a hardware-scaling result and it does not authorize training.
